mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% within a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings slowdowns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises above 4.5% within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue growth slows.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in the last 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 0.5% in the last 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as manufacturing slowdowns signal reduced corporate profitability and economic growth, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% annually signals persistent inflation, which typically triggers central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to hawkish policy signals.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises above 3.5% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A strong GDP growth (GDPC1) in the prior quarter signals robust economic expansion, which typically supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% in the prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) coupled with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a labor market contraction that typically precedes economic slowdowns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth rate < 0 and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in the last 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth rate is negative and UNRATE rises by more than 0.2 percentage points in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong consumer demand (RSAFS growth above 2% annually), the S&P 500 tends to outperform as corporate revenue growth accelerates, leading to positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 2% annually.
